# Contributing to Yak Ops

Yak Ops hosts an existing UI, an independent Flink CDC pipeline and a source-preserving Apache DolphinScheduler 3.4.3-release Scheduler migration.

Read DEVELOPMENT.md in the repository root before making changes. Imported Scheduler Java source is preserved for upstream comparability: consult yak-ops-scheduler/MIGRATION_MANIFEST.json and avoid incidental refactors while performing Maven or deployment adaptation.

Describe actual verification, including any tests or modules not run. Keep Apache-2.0 copyright/attribution, preserve source/test resources and discuss public compatibility changes before implementing them.

For focused contributions use the pull request template. The optional YOIP template remains available for major design discussions.
